name: epoll_create
description: epoll_create() creates a new epoll instance and returns a file descriptor for subsequent epoll operations. epoll_create1() is similar but allows specifying flags to modify behavior, such as setting close-on-exec.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Ignored since Linux 2.6.8, but must be greater than zero for epoll_create

parameters.name: flags
parameters.description: Flags to modify behavior, such as EPOLL_CLOEXEC for close-on-exec

return_value.success: Returns a file descriptor (a nonnegative integer)
return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and errno is set

errors.description: size is not positive for epoll_create, or invalid value specified in flags for epoll_create1
The per-process limit on the number of open file descriptors has been reached
The system-wide limit on the total number of open files has been reached
There was insufficient memory to create the kernel object

versions: Linux 2.6 for epoll_create, Linux 2.6.27 for epoll_create1
